versions.content: For an Eep module driving an external EEPROM through SPI: The Eep's configuration shall be such that the value of the configuration parameter 25 of 67 Document ID 21: AUTOSAR_SWS_EEPROMDriver Specification of EEPROM Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 EepNormalReadBlockSize fits to the number of bytes that are readable in normal SPI mode.
